title: Construct V_MoS6 pore supercell
action: Build a periodic MoS2 supercell (≥108 atoms) with a vacuum layer of ≥15 Å. Create the V_MoS6 pore by removing one Mo atom and three adjacent disulfur pairs (six S atoms). Save the structure.

title: DFT geometry optimization of the pore
action: Relax all atomic coordinates of the V_MoS6 supercell using DFT with PBE+optPBE vdW functional. Ensure a vacuum layer of ≥15 Å and save the relaxed coordinates.

title: Compute diffusion barriers and Bader charges
action: For each gas (He, Ne, H2, Ar, Kr), run a CI-NEB calculation with the same DFT functional. Extract the diffusion barrier as the energy difference between maximum and minimum along the converged path. For each gas, perform Bader analysis on a representative geometry inside the pore to compute net electron loss. Collect results in a CSV file.
description: CSV table with one row per gas containing computed diffusion barrier (eV) and net Bader charge loss (e).
